scope: The round-18 fix (6828bbb3: the lease reads the receive signal from atomics, not through nats.go's connection lock) and the merge of main 9c247139.

implementerProof.how: I re-ran each of the implementer's three proofs myself. (1) The unchanged red row at 9c247139, -count=7: 7 of 7 PASS, slowest message 12.025 s; the implementer reported 11.95 s over 3 runs. (2) The two new unit tests: they fail at 7494c07d with only the test file copied in (4.891 s and 4.898 s against a 100 ms bound) and pass 3 of 3 at 9c247139. (3) Multiprocess suite ok 708.281s (32 PASS); internal/bus under -race ok 345.391s; untagged ./cmd/listener ok 853.751s.

proof.criterion: A holder whose receive connection alone is lost, on a route that drops packets (reconnect dials hang), releases the lease, and a standby delivers within the 15 s hard bound (round-18 finding).
proof.surface: two real envoy-listener processes, signed in as the machine's nkey user under the rendered ListenerPermissions grant, against a real nats-server. pod-a's receive connection is cut by mpLaneRelay.cut, and blackholeNew holds every new dial; its lease connection stays up.
proof.observed: 7 of 7 PASS; slowest message per run 11.963, 11.946, 11.939, 11.957, 12.025, 12.014 and 11.953 s. A throwaway copy that logs the lease lines, 7 runs: pod-a logs 'listener lease released: the receive connection is down' once per run, 5.82-5.92 s after the cut, and its lease never lapses; pod-b logs 'listener lease acquired' from released 5.93-6.05 s after the cut; the first message after the cut arrives 11.94-12.07 s after; every message arrives once and in publish order.
proof.negativeControl: The same row on 7494c07d (before 6828bbb3), -count=2: FAIL 2 of 2, 'pod-a never released the lease for its lost receive connection' and '11 of 151 messages reached their session later than 15s'.

proof.criterion: Neither the lease's receive signal nor Client.Connected waits on nats.go's connection lock.
proof.surface: internal/bus client against a real nats-server while a reconnect dial hangs; the listener's receiver with the receive connection's locks held.
proof.command: cd packages/envoy && go test -count=3 -run TestConnectedAnswersWhileAReconnectDialHangs -v ./internal/bus/ && go test -count=3 -run TestTheReceiveSignalAnswersWhileTheReceiveConnectionsLocksAreHeld -v ./cmd/listener/
proof.negativeControl: At 7494c07d, with only the new test files copied in: 'Connected took 4.891114286s while nats.go held the connection's lock, want it within 100ms' and 'the receive signal took 4.89752939s to answer while the receive connection's locks were held, want it within 100ms'.

proof.criterion: No regression: the refused-reconnect row, a short cut, SIGKILL take-overs, every multiprocess row, internal/bus under -race, and the listener suite.
proof.surface: real listener binaries (multiprocess); the package suites.
